reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a crossed-out notification bell combined with three vertical soundwave bars, signifying muting alert sounds, spoken notifications, or alarms. While narrow, people genuinely write tasks to silence noisy apps, disable smart-home chimes, or turn off alarms before holidays. At list size it is easily confused with a standard slashed bell ('notifications off').
